tools.name: connect_domain

tools.name: check_domain

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, my_projects, list_sources, import_repo, list_environments, site_status, read_site, site_issues, refactor_site, data_api_grant, data_api_keys · Private data: search_docs, whoami, list_sources, import_repo, site_status, check_rules, env_vars, project_settings, connect_domain, check_domain, refactor_site, retry_deploy, diagnose_deploy, publish_site, data_api_status, data_api_methods, data_api_grant, data_api_keys, data_api_origins, data_api_probe · Public sink: import_repo, project_create, check_rules, read_site, site_screenshot, refactor_site, rollback, publish_site, publish_landing, data_api_probe · Destructive: check_rules, env_vars, check_performance, retry_deploy, publish_site, data_api_origins, data_api_probe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, my_projects, list_sources, import_repo, list_environments, site_status, read_site, site_issues, refactor_site, data_api_grant, data_api_keys · Private data: search_docs, whoami, list_sources, import_repo, site_status, check_rules, env_vars, project_settings, connect_domain, check_domain, refactor_site, retry_deploy, diagnose_deploy, publish_site, data_api_status, data_api_methods, data_api_grant, data_api_keys, data_api_origins, data_api_probe · Public sink: import_repo, project_create, check_rules, read_site, site_screenshot, refactor_site, rollback, publish_site, publish_landing, data_api_probe · Destructive: check_rules, env_vars, check_performance, retry_deploy, publish_site, data_api_origins, data_api_probe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
